_comment_credentials: Same three values the app's Sync page uses. The Pi is just another device on the nursery.
_comment_intervals: Seconds. Poll every minute, refresh the live card every 5, merge daily summaries every 30.
_comment_air: Plant ids (from each plant page, e.g. k3m9x2) that receive the cabinet's daily air/light summary. Usually ONE designated plant, so the document stays small - every bench tree sees the same air anyway.
_comment_chill: The olive's plant id. Its winter chill hours (below 45 F, counted hourly from the raw log, Nov 1 - Mar 1) land on its daily entry.
_comment_moisture: One block per capacitive probe. addr: 0x49/0x4a/0x4b as strapped (0x48 stays for the HAT's own ADC). channel: 0-3 on that board. dry/wet: raw counts from the calibration pass - probe dry in air, then submerged to the line.
_comment_relays: LOW-VOLTAGE LOADS ONLY (USB fan, humidifier DC side). All disabled until you enable them deliberately. Pins are BCM numbers. Sessions are local HH:MM with optional months (1-12); the winter humidifier sessions below are the bench packet's own table.
